items.q: Ray Brown says that you got to start the heart pumping

ctx.x: I'll make his break, because when he gets hot, man he's -- that four beats, you've got to have that four beat, me and the drummer --
Well, that's nice to hear, that makes me feel good. Yeah, Ray Brown says that you got to start the heart pumping, got to start the heart pumping with those four beats.
